blocks.text: GT cable networks exchange complete voltage/amperage packets. Calculator does not pretend those cables are a generic simulated FE battery. Output sends only packets the target advertises it can accept; input accepts only whole packets that fit the configured limits and FE buffer.

The shipped output is LV: 32 EU at one amp per tick. The shipped input budget is four amps per tick, shared across faces. These are defaults; the effective settings below are authoritative for your server.

A per-machine voltage or amperage override of zero inherits the global GT value. Battery charger/item tiers are separate from the cable settings. Refused over-voltage packets do not cause Calculator to explode. GT cables still apply their own cable losses.

rows: Confirm the installed GT version matches the pinned integration target in the source documentation.
Set compatible machine and cable tiers; do not use a larger ratio to imitate a voltage tier.
Set the face to the correct energy direction.
Check whether the shared per-tick amp budget is already exhausted by another face.
Use Power diagnostics on a nearby machine for the exact packet limits and refusal reason.
